Class AllocationResult

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.AllocationResult
public class AllocationResult extends Object
The AllocationResult is the object returned by a region allocation or a hot-page growth. The hot page is the page that currently receives new frames. The object stores whether the call succeeded. The object stores a RegionDescriptor. The object stores a status code from AllocationStatus. The object stores an error message. A caller reads those four values after the call. A null error message is stored as an empty string. The descriptor may be null when the call fails. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#AllocationResult roux-design.md

  • Constructor Details

    • AllocationResult

      public AllocationResult(boolean success, RegionDescriptor descriptor, int status, String errorMessage)
      The constructor stores the four values from an allocation or a growth. A null error message is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      success - The flag is true when the call succeeded.
      descriptor - The descriptor is the region after the call, and it may be null.
      status - The status is a code from AllocationStatus.
      errorMessage - The error message is the failure text, or an empty string.
